name: gator-workbench-frontend
description: Local engineering workbench UI. Tables, numbers, status and file lists. On-screen pictures by user decision only: the circuit graph view (2026-09-21, cytoscape) and the Training tab's charts of a run's recorded numbers (2026-10-05, record 7.193, uPlot), each loaded only when it is opened. Nothing drawn is ever written to a run's outputs.
